notes.key_messages:
• Candidates should take great care when drawing graphs to make sure that their sketches show the
correct behaviour near an asymptote. Sketches should be drawn and labelled with care.
• Candidates should ensure that they explain all steps in a solution, particularly when proving a given
• They should learn any standard formulae which are not on the formula sheet.
notes.general_comments:
The majority of candidates demonstrated very good knowledge across the whole syllabus, showed their
working clearly, and were accurate in their handling of algebra and calculus. They also showed
understanding of linear algebra. It appeared that all were able to complete the paper in the time allowed, and
a number of candidates had time to tackle both options for the final question. Work was generally well
presented, though graph sketching was less satisfactory.
